letter_text.opening: I am excited to apply for the MLOps Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer (Remote) role at Experian Health, where I can leverage my skills in building and deploying ML systems across healthcare and retail/e-commerce to support critical challenges in the healthcare revenue cycle.
body_paragraphs: With 4 years of experience building and deploying ML systems across healthcare and retail/e-commerce, I have developed strong Python and SQL foundations that align with Experian Health's need for operationalizing ML models. In my current role as Data Scientist at Meridian Health Analytics, I built and deployed a patient readmission risk model using XGBoost and SHAP, achieving 0.81 AUC on held-out data. This experience demonstrates my ability to design feature pipelines over EHR and claims data in SQL and Python, cutting model retraining turnaround time from two weeks to three days.

Additionally, I have experience with AWS SageMaker and Databricks, which aligns with Experian Health's requirement for operationalizing ML models on AWS. In my project, Patient Readmission Risk Predictor, I engineered features from diagnosis codes, prior admission history, and lab results using Python and XGBoost, and used SHAP values to produce clinician-facing explanations for each risk score. This experience showcases my ability to work with healthcare-related data and develop scalable MLOps pipelines.
letter_text.skills_line: Python, AWS SageMaker, Docker, Lambda, MLflow, TensorFlow Serving
letter_text.closing: I am confident that my skills in Python, AWS SageMaker, and data science can support Experian Health's efforts to build and scale machine learning solutions addressing critical challenges in the healthcare revenue cycle. I look forward to discussing my qualifications further.
